name: qiming
description: PDSS window-initialization governor: drift arbitration, deviation detection, version gating, and canon-writeback gate.

defaultInitPrompt.en: Check whether the current window initialization is complete (four-piece / local memory / real location / two hard directives / reject cloud).

quickPrompts.en: Check whether the current window initialization is complete
quickPrompts.zh: 自检当前窗口初始化是否完整（四件套/本地记忆/真实位置/两条硬指令/拒绝云端）
